chunks: And in a narration from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

The daughter of a brother and the daughter of a sister are not married alongside their paternal aunt or alongside their maternal aunt except with their permission; and the paternal aunt and the maternal aunt may be married alongside the daughter of a brother and the daughter of a sister without their permission.

key_terms.ابْنَةُ الْأَخِ: the daughter of one’s brother; a paternal niece
key_terms.ابْنَةُ الْأُخْتِ: the daughter of one’s sister; a maternal niece
key_terms.بِإِذْنِهِمَا: with the permission of the two women concerned
key_terms.بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِهِمَا: without the permission of the two women concerned
key_terms.تُنْكَحُ: is given in marriage or married

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible in Islamic law to marry a woman together with her niece without permission?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning marriage arrangements among close female kin. It establishes that marrying a niece together with her paternal or maternal aunt requires the aunt’s permission, while marrying the aunt alongside the niece does not require the niece’s permission.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4438 - And in a narration from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), who said:

"The daughter of a brother and the daughter of a sister cannot be married alongside their paternal or maternal aunt except with their permission. However, the paternal and maternal aunt can be married alongside the daughter of a brother or the daughter of a sister without requiring their permission."
